wizard.title: Transfer project
wizard.description: Move {domain} to another Bisibility instance ({target} by default). The source project stays read-only while export and import finish.

validation.token: Paste the migration token from the destination.

gate.checkCurrent: Run a current compatibility check before continuing.

gate.exportPackage: Export the project package before continuing.
gate.confirmUpload: Confirm the destination upload before continuing.

check.title: Check compatibility
check.body: Make sure the destination instance can accept this project before anything is paused or transferred.
check.preflightHint: Transfer runs the destination preflight again, so a target changed after this check is still rejected before import.
check.destinationHelp: Prefilled from this instance's configuration. You can change it before running the check.
check.invalidTarget: Enter a valid destination URL, then run the check again.
check.failureDetail: The check itself didn't run - this is usually a network hiccup. Try again in a moment.
check.holdPendingTitle: Read-only mode is confirmed at the next step
check.holdActiveBody: Writes and rank checks stay paused until you cancel the migration.
check.holdPendingBody: After all gates pass, Continue asks you to confirm pausing writes and rank checks before the transfer starts.

pending.readyDetail: Run the check to confirm this project can move to the destination.
pending.destinationDetail: No response recorded yet for this destination.
pending.planDetail: Keyword and history counts appear here after the check.

result.ready: All checks passed ({checkedAt}). Continue to start the transfer.
result.blocked: This project can't transfer yet. Fix the issues below, then run the check again.
result.unreachable: We couldn't reach it. Check the URL and that the instance is online.

error.MIG-101: We couldn't reach the destination instance.

error.MIG-103: The destination didn't report which import formats it supports.

error.MIG-105: The destination address points at this same instance.

blocker.MIG-101: Check the URL is correct and the destination instance is online.
blocker.MIG-102: Update the destination to the latest version, then re-run the check.
blocker.MIG-103: Update the destination to the latest version, then re-run the check.
blocker.MIG-104: Update the destination to the latest version, then re-run the check.
blocker.MIG-105: Pick a different destination. The resolved address is {origin}.{deploymentHint, select, selfHost { If this is meant to be a hosted deployment, it likely needs DEPLOYMENT_MODE set to cloud.} other {}}
blocker.default: See the migration guide for fixes.

details.protocol: Required import protocol v{version}; destination declares {declared}

hold.banner: Read-only mode is on. Writes and rank checks stay paused while this migration is in progress. It releases only when you cancel the migration, or automatically after 24 hours of inactivity.
hold.enableBody: Continuing puts this project into read-only mode for everyone. Writes and scheduled rank checks are paused so the data cannot change while it transfers.
hold.enableNote: Read-only mode stays on until you cancel the migration - it cannot be switched off from the next steps. If nothing happens for 24 hours it releases automatically.
hold.migratedBody: This disables the source project for good: writes and rank checks stay off and the state does not auto-release. Do this once you've verified the destination project.
hold.migratedNote: You can reactivate the project later from Settings if you ever need it again.
hold.cancelBody: This releases the migration hold and resumes writes and rank checks on this project. If any data already reached the destination, the two instances will drift apart from this point.
hold.progressBody: This project stays read-only while the migration is in progress. You can close this window and come back later - or cancel the migration to resume writes.
hold.autoRelease: Migration holds also auto-release after 24 hours of inactivity.

error.enable: Read-only mode could not be enabled.
error.release: Read-only mode could not be released.
error.markMigrated: Project could not be marked as migrated.

transfer.confirmReady: Confirm only after the destination import page accepts the uploaded package.
transfer.confirmPending: Export the project package before confirming the manual upload.
transfer.confirmLabel: I uploaded the package; await confirmation on the destination
transfer.manualNote: Manual transfer cannot verify the remote import from this source. The final screen will remain awaiting external confirmation until you verify the destination separately.
transfer.createToken: Create a migration token on the {target} destination
transfer.tokenSource: The destination import page mints the mig_... token. It is shown once there - copy it before leaving that page.

handoff.title: {target} handoff
handoff.description: Opens the destination import flow where the migration token is created.
handoff.completedDescription: {domain} was accepted and committed by the destination. Keep this source project as rollback until you verify the migrated project.
handoff.pendingDescription: The package left this source flow, but {target} has not reported a completed import here. Verify the destination before releasing read-only mode.
handoff.generateUrl: Generate the {target} handoff to copy a real URL
handoff.reconnect: Re-connect SERP and analytics providers on the destination before resuming scheduled checks.
handoff.sourceHeld: Keep it read-only while you verify the {target} project, then mark it as migrated to disable it for good. Cancelling resumes writes here and the instances may drift apart.
handoff.sourceActive: Writes are active on this source project.
